description: Returns the guarantors, named parties and contacts that SEC filings give for one loan (prospectus Annex A-1 and the trust's 10-D), each with a link to its filing. Use it after get_loan when asked who stands behind a loan. Without a paid cmbs.news plan it returns only how many are on file.
